Trigger, what happens, outcomes and timeouts

Trigger
No record to count: No move carries delivery in the code: the order status enum ends at Shipped, the ship command is the last status change, and the only handler of OrderStatusChangedToShippedIntegrationEvent posts to webhook subscribers and records no delivery.
